description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing submission-related operations such as creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions within a data insights dashboard. It includes API endpoints with associated request handling logic, authentication, and authorization checks.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router object used to define API endpoints with path prefixes, tags, and response configurations.

methods.name: CreateSubmissionResponse create_submission( request: CreateSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new submission, including authentication and authorization checks, invoking submission service, and returning the result.

methods.name: GetSubmissionResponse get_submission( submission_id: str, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a submission by ID, including validation status, after authentication.

methods.name: TriggerValidationResponse trigger_validation( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Triggers a validation run for a specific submission, with authentication and validation checks.

methods.name: ApproveSubmissionResponse approve_submission( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
methods.description: Processes approval or rejection of a submission, handling multiple error cases such as auth, SoD, signature, and state validations.

ctags.name: approve_submission
ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: ApproveSubmissionRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )

ctags.name: trigger_validation
ctags.signature: ( submission_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Security(security), )
